import httpx
from api_fetch import fetch_json


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, paginating through all pages."""
    titles = []
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}
    url = "/tickets"
    while url is not None:
        data = fetch_json(client, url, params=params)
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in data["items"])
        url = data.get("next")
    return titles

import httpx
from api_fetch import fetch_json


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, following pagination."""
    titles = []
    status = "open"
    url = "/tickets"
    params = {"status": status, "project": project}
    max_pages = 100  # safety limit to avoid infinite loops

    for _ in range(max_pages):
        data = fetch_json(client, url, params=params)
        for item in data["items"]:
            titles.append(item["title"])
        next_url = data.get("next")
        if not next_url:
            break
        # For next requests, send the next_url as path and keep params as required
        url = next_url
        # params remain the same for every request as required by the server
    return titles
